definitions.observedTick: One unique SDK observation tick transition; revisions within a tick are merged, duplicate revisions ignored. Evidence flags OR across publications. Tick is finalized at next transition or exact deadline.
definitions.knownDenominator: 3000 observed buckets including one first-boundary unknown; 2999 classify as known. No missing tick numbers, resets, invalid ticks or dropped writes. A real same-millisecond burst tick remains in count with zero elapsed weight.
definitions.confirmedVisibleIdle: Fresh, physically stationary, no observed item/XP effect, no animation/combat evidence, no owned active helper/gather lease and no cooldown. Includes no-approved-work starvation and stationary controller failure/recovery pauses, shown separately. This is a controller-observable lower-bound estimate, not proof about hidden server work.
definitions.possibleIdle: Stationary no-progress/animation periods with a pending helper/gather lease or unresolved queued eligibility; a promise is never evidence of productivity.
definitions.busyUnproven: Animation/combat evidence with no observed progress in that bucket; no claim every such tick was productive.
definitions.progress: Any observed movement or inventory/XP delta in a tick. A no-XP tick is not automatically idle; random gathering attempts may fail.
definitions.eligibleQueuedIdle: Only a conservative side-effect-free walk subset has full known eligibility checked; other queued no-dispatch work is unresolved. No such tick occurred here.
definitions.planning: All claim-to-completion intervals, whether gameplay-only or mixed development/report-support. The original 969/1055 figure is preserved for this broad instrumented scope; it must not be called pure gameplay thinking or isolated inference.
definitions.planningOverlap: Tick counted once in union if any part overlaps claimed interval; individual window counts may touch boundary ticks. Seconds use actual overlap of observed timestamp intervals, not whole-tick multiplication.
definitions.seconds: Estimated from observed publication interval duration; no synchronized server phase. Unobserved initial 160ms is not idle.
definitions.pauses: Live collector originally combines paused/cooldown flags. Offline analyzer explicitly splits cooldown from stationary controller pauses; no maintenance/safety pause was requested in this run. All failed/recovery periods remain.
definitions.outsidePlanning: All time outside explicit claims remains in whole-run totals, including monitoring, updates and support work. Development/report support ALSO occurred inside six claims; only the audited subset removes entire known/uncertain mixed windows.
definitions.gameplayPlanningOnly: Transcript-audited subset retaining original indices 2,3,4,6,7,9,13,14,15; exclude entire mixed/uncertain windows 1,5,8,10,11,12 based on activities, not tick outcomes. No exact developer durations are known. Retained intervals still include game-related tools and scheduling overhead.

collectorOverhead.meaning: Synchronous subscriber CPU wall-time; callbacks include inactive pre/post boundary no-op callbacks. File writes are private asynchronous batches of 64 with bounded pending-write backlog; no high-frequency full-state polling. One source subscription, plus low-rate tool/status observation.

limitations: This cloud agent and its tool scheduling were tested, not the separate Wartime environment/model or isolated inference.
Single character/session/workload, 20 minutes, not proof of unlimited autonomy or PvP ability. No public chat/PvP action.

Many full routines failed or required replanning; this is not a successful low-idle benchmark. Observed skill XP may increase even when an SDK helper reports failure; verified actions and actual XP are kept separate.
All-claim intervals include mixed gameplay and developer/report work. Use gameplayPlanningOnly for the conservative narrower subset; whole-run and original all-claim totals remain intact.
Standing still alone is not idle. Busy animation may still hide ineffective work; helper ambiguity could contain useful attempts or wasted time. Missing ticks are not invented as idle.

Idle is a conservative observation-based estimate; no server execution trace or authoritative hidden-action state. Small boundary uncertainty at tick/window edges and millisecond clock quantization remain.

Plans intentionally adapted to targets, inventory, failures and available oak as ordinary progression; executor and measurement source stayed fixed. No comparison claiming that changing workload optimized the controller.
Final stop happens after measurement; cancellation/cleanup ticks are excluded. Earlier historical reports are unchanged.

auditCorrection.method: Review all 15 windows against the command/activity sequence, preserving the fixed raw trace. Entire known/uncertain mixed windows excluded before examining subset arithmetic; no guessed within-window developer durations and no outcome-based filtering.
